system.effect:
Trigger - You hit with @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.XQOEuOenSzYNz4eO]{Leer}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.43i757GW8pptWB5j]{Confide}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.dIkyKSyZGctjHX9O]{Baby-Doll Eyes}, or a Provocateur Move
Effect: The Move gains additional effects as listed below. You may use the effects of each Move only once per Scene.
»» Baby-Doll Eyes: The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.ABTHN2VM50VQabZq]{Infatuated} with you for the rest of the Scene, and cannot be cured of this condition by any means, including @UUID[Compendium.ptu.journals.JournalEntry.NuifZmyV41EwsMns.JournalEntryPage.kh6plRgPLPwlnnlY]{Taking a Breather}. This does not bypass immunity to Infatuation.
»» Confide: You choose a Move the target has used this Scene. That Move becomes @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.GUKAMwsFi0EJ56WD]{Disabled} for the target.
»» Leer: The target’s Defense is lowered an additional Combat Stage, and their Special Defense is lowered by 2 Combat Stages.
»» @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.0cpoDUWBYwTiDlnG]{Sweet Kiss}: While the target is @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.pLKjxFPUOZQHAcXH]{Confused}, they may not perform @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.SY3j4DR2EGyRkvRr]{Disengage} Maneuvers, and whenever they hit themselves in Confusion, they provoke an @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.lhaZXnE2PfttWp41]{Attack of Opportunity} from all of their adjacent foes.
»» @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.PPcOINwAtEYByNNN]{Taunt}: For 1 full round, the next damaging attack to hit the target of Taunt deals +3d8+10 Damage.
»» @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.zgeymOL0WIKgT6lq]{Torment}: The target’s Ability is disabled until the end of the encounter. If the target has more than one Ability, you choose one of them to disable.
»» @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.FtteBhLvsPR6XCEk]{Lovely Kiss}: The target’s Evasion is lowered by 2 for the rest of the Scene.
prerequisites: a Provocateur Skill at Expert Rank
system.name: Play Them Like a Fiddle
